name: oh-my-days

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.landing.json
scripts.check: npm run build:app && npm run build:landing && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.deploy: npm run check && node scripts/production-config.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/production-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply oh-my-days --remote --config wrangler.production.jsonc

description: A Telegram assistant for events and tasks, with Google Calendar as the calendar.
